summary: Frontend-only regression pass for Phase 2A.2c completed. Expo web preview boots, invalid chat route now renders fallback without crash-loop evidence, and no new runtime/bundle break was observed from PollComposer/MediaBubble/chat imports in unauthenticated mode. Auth-gated chat validation remains blocked by non-deterministic third-party OIDC flow in automation.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking sign-in button did not produce deterministic navigation/popup in browser automation, so authenticated path could not be entered.

integration_issues.issue: Unable to reach authenticated chats in this run due external OIDC interaction behavior; poll/document rendering in live authenticated conversation remains unverified.

action_items: Stabilize web auth launch signal/redirect behavior so sign-in-btn can be validated deterministically in CI automation.
After auth entry is testable, retest authenticated chat conversation with poll and document messages to confirm end-to-end render and interactions.
Keep tracking Expo warnings (expo-av deprecation and shadow/pointerEvents web warnings) before SDK upgrades.
critical_code_review_comments: app/chat/[conversationId].tsx is still very large (>1100 lines), increasing regression risk and making future RCA harder.
app/chat/[conversationId].tsx contains an unused local MessageBubble implementation while MediaBubble is the active renderer (dead/duplicate code risk).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/memory/test_credentials.md before any auth attempt. Root and invalid chat route checks passed in this run with no maximum-update-depth error observed in console logs. Auth flow is still third-party OIDC and not deterministic in browser automation.
rca_of_issue: Auth verification gap repro: open root, click [data-testid='sign-in-btn'], wait 5s for popup/event and URL change; no deterministic popup or route transition observed in this run, so authenticated chat-state checks cannot proceed. Invalid route repro: open /chat/test-conversation and wait ~4.5s; fallback UI renders and remained stable in this run.
